messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: openCR age modelling
parts:
openCR.fit() automatically applies join() if the capthist input has a multi-session structure. It doesn't work any differently for age models, and you should get the same result by applying join() yourself. I would be interested if you can provide a simple working example where it has an effect. Perhaps there is some subtle difference in the specification of intervals, or the dots argument of your call to openCR.fit() is passing something unintended to join().
Murray
